Good morning, everyone. This is Ray Collins with the plan for today. Listen carefully, because the north area is closed all week. Come in through the main gate, not through the small entrance on the west side. After the gate, walk along the fence, on the yellow walkway, never on the road. You pass three containers on your right. Our office is the second one, at ground level. The ramp into the tunnel is behind the containers, and nobody goes down there before eight. Thank you, and have a safe shift.

Hi Giovanna, it is Karen. You asked me what my site looks like from above, so here it is. Imagine a big grey rectangle with a blue fence around it. There is one entrance for people and one gate for the trucks, fifty meters away. Inside, there are two areas: the office area, with four containers, and the work area, with the machines. A yellow walkway goes across the middle, from the entrance to the ramp. And then the interesting part is underground. The tunnel runs under the street, twenty meters below our feet. I never see it from my window, but it is there, and my crew is in it right now.

Giovanna comes in through the main gate. She walks along the fence, on the yellow walkway. She goes across the yard and into the office container. After the meeting she walks down the ramp. Twenty meters underground, she inspects the tunnel wall.
